exposure: Feeding type during the first 4 months
Infants fed both breast milk and formula
feeding type (breast milk, formula, or both)
Feeding type (breast milk, formula, or both)
cohort: 1003 infants from a single suburban pediatrics practice
finding: The study found a 17% cumulative incidence of FPIAP, with combination feeding (breast milk and formula) being associated with the lowest risk of developing FPIAP.
mod_finding: Infants initially fed both breast milk and formula were 61% less likely to develop food protein-induced allergic proctocolitis (FPIAP) compared with those exclusively formula-fed.
